Notes from the workshop

Building a wooden desk begins with a careful plan and a stable work surface. This guide follows the process from choosing straight boards through measuring, cutting, and assembling each part safely. Read the complete guide for more information. Use careful measurements and an accurate square.

Preparing the pieces

Mark each board before cutting and check every measurement twice. A square edge makes the later joints easier to align, and a light sanding removes rough spots without changing the final dimensions.

  • Measure each board
  • Check every joint

Finishing

Apply a protective finish in a ventilated area and allow every coat to dry before handling the desk.
